import hashlib, json, os, re, statistics, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out=root/'build/guile'
guile='/nix/store/ayvbwi3g20975ad2gqxq11wg5wn0sjjn-guile-3.0.11/bin/guile'
chez='/nix/store/bzqpmy5kmvf0xn4xh5ixzkw00w9srh07-chez-scheme-10.4.1/bin/scheme'
chibi='/nix/store/rymbc3gyix886hxf3ns6cr7smmc9swy2-chibi-scheme-0.12/bin/chibi-scheme'
load='(load-compiled "build/guile/cpu.go")'
commands={
 'llvm-baseline':[str(out/'llvm-baseline'),'64'],
 'llvm-tuned':[str(out/'llvm-tuned'),'64'],
 'chez':[chez,'--program',str(out/'cpu-chez.so'),'64'],
 'guile':[guile,'--no-auto-compile','--r7rs','-c',load,'64'],
 'guile-warm':[guile,'--no-auto-compile','--r7rs','-c',load+' (main)','64'],
 'chibi':[chibi,str(out/'cpu-chibi.scm'),'64']}
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{2})
samples=[]
diagnostics={}
def sample(name,command):
 r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
 checksums=re.findall(r'checksum: (\d+)',r.stdout)
 assert len(checksums)==(2 if name=='guile-warm' else 1),r.stdout
 assert all(int(n)==269118144 for n in checksums),r.stdout
 times=re.findall(r'elapsed: ([\d.]+) s',r.stdout)
 assert len(times)==len(checksums),r.stdout
 if r.stderr:diagnostics[name]=r.stderr
 row={'variant':name,'seconds':float(times[-1]),'checksum':269118144}
 if len(times)>1:row['untimed_warmup_seconds']=float(times[0])
 return row
for name,command in commands.items():sample(name,command)
items=list(commands.items())
for round in range(8):
 offset=round%len(items)
 for name,command in items[offset:]+items[:offset]:
  row=sample(name,command);row['round']=round+1;samples.append(row)
medians={name:statistics.median(r['seconds'] for r in samples if r['variant']==name) for name in commands}
paths=[root/'benchmarks/cpu.scm',out/'cpu.go',out/'cpu-chez.so',out/'cpu-chibi.scm',out/'llvm-tuned',out/'llvm-baseline']
build_commands=[
 [str(Path(guile).with_name('guild')),'compile','--r7rs','-O2','-o','build/guile/cpu.go','benchmarks/cpu.scm'],
 [chez,'--script','benchmarks/chez.scm','benchmarks/cpu.scm','build/guile/cpu-chez.so'],
 [chibi,'benchmarks/chibi.scm','benchmarks/cpu.scm','build/guile/cpu-chibi.scm']]
report={
 'revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),
 'method':'Eight rotating rounds pinned to CPU2; fresh process per sample; 64 repetitions; checksum269118144; program internal timer excludes ahead-of-time compilation and process startup; discard one fresh-process sample per variant.',
 'guile':'3.0.11, guild compile --r7rs -O2 (all optimizations; same passes as -O3). Default runtime settings; no auto-compilation. guile-warm invokes main a second time in the same process after a full 64-repetition warmup and records only the second interval. Runtime JIT work, if any, is included in measured intervals.',
 'scope':'Guile/Chez/Chibi execute the complete unchanged canonical Scheme workload. LLVM variants compile the extracted recursive Fibonacci through the bounded Wasm->LLVM experiment and use its C outer harness. Tuned LLVM uses static boolean objects and cold noinline numeric fallbacks, as in 2026-10-10-llvm-codegen.json; not the complete production backend.',
 'build_commands':build_commands,'commands':commands,'samples':samples,'median_seconds':medians,
 'time_over_chez':{n:t/medians['chez'] for n,t in medians.items()},
 'time_over_tuned_llvm':{n:t/medians['llvm-tuned'] for n,t in medians.items()},
 'sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},
 'guile_executable_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(guile).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'environment':{k:os.environ.get(k) for k in ['GUILE_JIT_THRESHOLD','GUILE_AUTO_COMPILE','GUILE_LOAD_PATH','GUILE_LOAD_COMPILED_PATH']},
 'versions':{'guile':subprocess.check_output([guile,'--version'],text=True).splitlines()[0],
 'chez':subprocess.check_output([chez,'--version'],text=True,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).strip(),
 'chibi':subprocess.check_output([chibi,'-V'],text=True,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).strip()},
 'host':subprocess.check_output(['uname','-a'],text=True).strip(),
 'diagnostics':diagnostics,'measurement_script':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'seconds':medians,'time_over_chez':report['time_over_chez'],'time_over_tuned_llvm':report['time_over_tuned_llvm']},indent=2))
